title: Igunya Elingagungqiyo
intro: Kumazwe amandulo, igunya elinamandla lalikhe lalawula, lilawula izixhobo ezininzi kunye nobomi babantu abaninzi. Nangona kwakukho imiqondiso nezilumkiso ezicacileyo, lo mlawuli wakhetha indlela yokungavumi, nto leyo eyakhokelela kwingxabano enkulu eyayiza kuvakala ngokuhamba kwexesha.
clues: Ndathi ndinegunya elikhulu phezu kommandla omkhulu.
Ndimcelile umngeni umthunywa othobekileyo othunywe yiNkosi yazo zonke iindawo.
Abantu bakuthi babesaziwa ngobuchule babo bokwakha izakhiwo ezinkulu kunye nomlambo owawuxhasa impucuko yethu.
Ndabona imiqondiso emininzi emangalisayo, kuquka intonga eguqukayo yaba yinyoka kunye nesandla esikhanyayo.
Andizange ndivume ukuba iqela labantu abakhotyokisiweyo lishiye ilizwe lam, nangona ndandinikwe imiyalelo kaThixo.
Ukusukela kwam abantu ababehamba kwandikhokelela mna nemikhosi yam embindini wolwandle olwahlulwe phakathi.
arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا غَـٰفِلِينَ
verse: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them. (7:136)
